name: Isola's Spooky Soiree - An Egg Factory Game
source:
You've received a mysterious invitation to Isola's Spooky Soiree. You have no idea who Isola is, but you're always down for an awesome Halloween party! There you'll meet some interesting characters as you explore Isola's factory. It's sure to be a great time.

[From [url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/isolas-spooky-soiree]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你收到了一份参加伊索拉幽灵晚会的神秘邀请。你不知道伊索拉是谁，但你总是渴望参加一场精彩的万圣节派对！当你探索伊索拉的工厂时，你会遇到一些有趣的人物。这肯定是一段美好的时光。

[来自[url=https://gewi-studios.itch.io/isolas-spooky-soiree]Itch.io[/url]]
